alertmanager-ntfy.extraConfigFiles.description:
Config files to merge into the settings defined in [](#opt-services.prometheus.alertmanager-ntfy.settings).
This is useful to avoid putting secrets into the Nix store.
See <https://github.com/alexbakker/alertmanager-ntfy> for more information.

alertmanager-ntfy.settings.description:
Configuration of alertmanager-ntfy.
See <https://github.com/alexbakker/alertmanager-ntfy> for more information.

alertmanager.checkConfig.description:
Check configuration with `amtool check-config`. The call to `amtool` is
subject to sandboxing by Nix.

If you use credentials stored in external files
(`environmentFile`, etc),
they will not be visible to `amtool`
and it will report errors, despite a correct configuration.

alertmanager.configText.description:
Alertmanager configuration as YAML text. If non-null, this option
defines the text that is written to alertmanager.yml. If null, the
contents of alertmanager.yml is generated from the structured config
options.

The contents of the resulting config file are processed using envsubst.
`$` needs to be escaped as `$$` to be preserved.

alertmanager.configuration.description:
Alertmanager configuration as nix attribute set.

The contents of the resulting config file are processed using envsubst.
`$` needs to be escaped as `$$` to be preserved.

alertmanager.environmentFile.description:
File to load as environment file. Environment variables
from this file will be interpolated into the config file
using envsubst with this syntax:
`$ENVIRONMENT ${VARIABLE}`

alertmanager.extraFlags.description: Extra commandline options when launching the Alertmanager.

alertmanager.listenAddress.description:
Address to listen on for the web interface and API. Empty string will listen on all interfaces.
"localhost" will listen on 127.0.0.1 (but not ::1).

alertmanager.logFormat.description: If set use a syslog logger or JSON logging.

alertmanager.logLevel.description: Only log messages with the given severity or above.

alertmanager.openFirewall.description: Open port in firewall for incoming connections.

alertmanager.port.description: Port to listen on for the web interface and API.

alertmanager.webExternalUrl.description:
The URL under which Alertmanager is externally reachable (for example, if Alertmanager is served via a reverse proxy).
Used for generating relative and absolute links back to Alertmanager itself.
If the URL has a path portion, it will be used to prefix all HTTP endoints served by Alertmanager.
If omitted, relevant URL components will be derived automatically.

alertmanagerGotify.bindAddress.description: The address the server will listen on (bind address).

alertmanagerGotify.debug.description: Enables extended logs for debugging purposes. Should be disabled in productive mode.

alertmanagerGotify.defaultPriority.description: The default priority for messages sent to gotify.

alertmanagerGotify.dispatchErrors.description: When enabled, alerts will be tried to dispatch with an error message regarding faulty templating or missing fields to help debugging.

alertmanagerGotify.environmentFile.description:
File containing additional config environment variables for alertmanager-gotify-bridge.
This is especially for secrets like GOTIFY_TOKEN and AUTH_PASSWORD.

alertmanagerGotify.extendedDetails.description: When enabled, alerts are presented in HTML format and include colorized status (FIR|RES), alert start time, and a link to the generator of the alert.

alertmanagerGotify.gotifyEndpoint.host.description: The hostname or ip your gotify endpoint is running.

alertmanagerGotify.gotifyEndpoint.port.description: The port your gotify endpoint is running.

alertmanagerGotify.gotifyEndpoint.tls.description: If your gotify endpoint uses https, leave this option set to default

alertmanagerGotify.metrics.path.description: The path under which the metrics will be exposed.

alertmanagerGotify.metrics.username.description: The username used to access your metrics.

alertmanagerGotify.openFirewall.description: Opens the bridge port in the firewall.

alertmanagerGotify.port.description: The local port the bridge is listening on.

alertmanagerGotify.priorityAnnotation.description: Annotation holding the priority of the alert.

alertmanagerGotify.timeout.description: The time between sending a message and the timeout.

alertmanagerGotify.titleAnnotation.description: Annotation holding the title of the alert

alertmanagerGotify.webhookPath.description: The URL path to handle requests on.

alertmanagerIrcRelay.enable.description: Whether to enable Alertmanager IRC Relay.

alertmanagerIrcRelay.extraFlags.description: Extra command line options to pass to alertmanager-irc-relay.

alertmanagerIrcRelay.settings.description:
Configuration for Alertmanager IRC Relay as a Nix attribute set.
For a reference, check out the
[example configuration](https://github.com/google/alertmanager-irc-relay#configuring-and-running-the-bot)
and the
[source code](https://github.com/google/alertmanager-irc-relay/blob/master/config.go).

Note: The webhook's URL MUST point to the IRC channel where the message
should be posted. For `#mychannel` from the example, this would be
`http://localhost:8080/mychannel`.

alertmanagerNotificationQueueCapacity.description: The capacity of the queue for pending alert manager notifications.

alertmanagerWebhookLogger.enable.description: Whether to enable Alertmanager Webhook Logger.

alertmanagerWebhookLogger.extraFlags.description: Extra command line options to pass to alertmanager-webhook-logger.

alertmanagers.description:
A list of alertmanagers to send alerts to.
See [the official documentation](https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/configuration/configuration/#alertmanager_config) for more information.

checkConfig.description:
Check configuration with `promtool check`. The call to `promtool` is
subject to sandboxing by Nix.

If you use credentials stored in external files
(`password_file`, `bearer_token_file`, etc),
they will not be visible to `promtool`
and it will report errors, despite a correct configuration.
To resolve this, you may set this option to `"syntax-only"`
in order to only syntax check the Prometheus configuration.

configText.description:
If non-null, this option defines the text that is written to
prometheus.yml. If null, the contents of prometheus.yml is generated
from the structured config options.

enable.description: Whether to enable Prometheus monitoring daemon.

enableReload.description:
Reload prometheus when configuration file changes (instead of restart).

The following property holds: switching to a configuration
(`switch-to-configuration`) that changes the prometheus
configuration only finishes successfully when prometheus has finished
loading the new configuration.

extraFlags.description: Extra commandline options when launching Prometheus.

globalConfig.description:
Parameters that are valid in all  configuration contexts. They
also serve as defaults for other configuration sections

listenAddress.description: Address to listen on for the web interface, API, and telemetry.

pushgateway.extraFlags.description: Extra commandline options when launching the Pushgateway.

pushgateway.log.format.description:
Set the log target and format.

`null` will default to `logger:stderr`.

pushgateway.log.level.description:
Only log messages with the given severity or above.

`null` will default to `info`.

pushgateway.persistMetrics.description:
Whether to persist metrics to a file.

When enabled metrics will be saved to a file called
`metrics` in the directory
`/var/lib/pushgateway`. The directory below
`/var/lib` can be set using
{option}`services.prometheus.pushgateway.stateDir`.

pushgateway.persistence.interval.description:
The minimum interval at which to write out the persistence file.

`null` will default to `5m`.

pushgateway.stateDir.description:
Directory below `/var/lib` to store metrics.

This directory will be created automatically using systemd's
StateDirectory mechanism when
{option}`services.prometheus.pushgateway.persistMetrics`
is enabled.

pushgateway.web.external-url.description: The URL under which Pushgateway is externally reachable.

pushgateway.web.listen-address.description:
Address to listen on for the web interface, API and telemetry.

`null` will default to `:9091`.

pushgateway.web.route-prefix.description:
Prefix for the internal routes of web endpoints.

Defaults to the path of
{option}`services.prometheus.pushgateway.web.external-url`.

pushgateway.web.telemetry-path.description:
Path under which to expose metrics.

`null` will default to `/metrics`.

remoteRead.description:
Parameters of the endpoints to query from.
See [the official documentation](https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/configuration/configuration/#remote_read) for more information.

remoteWrite.description:
Parameters of the endpoints to send samples to.
See [the official documentation](https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/configuration/configuration/#remote_write) for more information.

retentionTime.description: How long to retain samples in storage.

ruleFiles.description: Any additional rules files to include in this configuration.

rules.description: Alerting and/or Recording rules to evaluate at runtime.

sachet.address.description: The address Sachet will listen to.

sachet.configuration.description: Sachet's configuration as a nix attribute set.

sachet.enable.description: Whether to enable Sachet, an SMS alerting tool for the Prometheus Alertmanager.

sachet.port.description: The port Sachet will listen to.

stateDir.description:
Directory below `/var/lib` to store Prometheus metrics data.
This directory will be created automatically using systemd's StateDirectory mechanism.

webConfigFile.description:
Specifies which file should be used as web.config.file and be passed on startup.
See <https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/configuration/https/> for valid options.

webExternalUrl.description:
The URL under which Prometheus is externally reachable (for example,
if Prometheus is served via a reverse proxy).

xmpp-alerts.enable.description: Whether to enable XMPP Web hook service for Alertmanager.

xmpp-alerts.settings.description:
Configuration for prometheus xmpp-alerts, see
<https://github.com/jelmer/prometheus-xmpp-alerts/blob/master/xmpp-alerts.yml.example>
for supported values.
